summary: Ally Financial filed an 8-K reporting a routine shelf takedown: a $750 million offering of 5.525% fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2030, issued September 16, 2026 under an existing Form S-3 shelf. The underwriting agreement, dated September 9, 2026, was signed with BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, TD Securities and Wells Fargo as representatives. Proceeds are general corporate funding, not a special situation. Watch for spread performance and any use-of-proceeds disclosure, but no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
